metadata.name: spin-half clean chart exact derivation audit candidate
metadata.status: finite audit of the remaining exact Kerr derivation obligations for the first Carter chart; not a derivation of q_grav

primitive_derivation_registry.name: radial_hessian_packet
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: the radial Hessian packet h*x^2 is derived from the gauge-reduced spin-1/2 Teukolsky radial operator (xi_r -> Delta^{-1/2} x gauge reduction, positivity weight rho renormalization) and proved equal to h*x^2 with h = -rho/Delta by the radial-Hessian derivation checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: superradiant_square_packet
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: the superradiant-square packet s*(ell - c*x)^2 is derived from the gauge-reduced spin-1/2 Teukolsky superradiant sector (superradiant frequency shift ell = omega - m_phi*Omega_H, radial-superradiant coupling c = Omega_H*Delta/P, positivity weight rho renormalization) and proved equal to s*(ell - c*x)^2 with s = rho*ell^2/Delta by the superradiant-square derivation checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: carter_scale_packet
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: the Carter-scale packet tau*q^2 is derived from the gauge-reduced spin-1/2 Teukolsky angular operator (xi_theta -> sin(theta)*q gauge reduction, positivity weight rho renormalization) and proved equal to tau*q^2 with tau = rho/sin^2(theta) by the Carter-scale derivation checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: diagonal_slack_packet
primitive_derivation_registry.verification_interface: rational coefficient extraction and coefficient-enclosure chain
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: export exact rational interval remainders from the Kerr coefficient extraction and verify that all diagonal slack terms lie inside the accepted coefficient tube

primitive_derivation_registry.name: bilinear_slack_packet
primitive_derivation_registry.verification_interface: rational coefficient extraction and coefficient-enclosure chain
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: export exact rational interval remainders from the Kerr coefficient extraction and verify that all bilinear slack terms lie inside the accepted coefficient tube

primitive_derivation_registry.name: trapped_radial_constraint_correction
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: derive the exact multiple of the trapped radial equation R=0 and verify its ideal membership with the source-ideal checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: trapped_derivative_constraint_correction
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: derive the exact multiple of the differentiated trapped equation dR=0 and verify its ideal membership with the source-ideal checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: radial_trapped_constraint
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: rho_R is derived from the normalized trapped characteristic equation R=0 and proved equal to the backend exported residual by the trapped-constraint derivation checker

primitive_derivation_registry.name: radial_derivative_trapped_constraint
primitive_derivation_registry.replacement_criterion: rho_dR is derived from the normalized differentiated trapped characteristic equation dR=0 and proved equal to the backend exported residual by the trapped-constraint derivation checker

backend_obligation_registry.name: derive the gauge-reduced linearized vacuum Einstein principal symbol in this chart
backend_obligation_registry.replacement_criterion: register a symbolic differentiation backend that expands the gauge-reduced linearized vacuum Einstein principal symbol into the traced primitive packets

backend_obligation_registry.name: compute the normalized gravitational principal density q_grav in the listed phase variables
backend_obligation_registry.replacement_criterion: export the exact normalized q_grav phase polynomial and prove equality with the backend source density modulo the registered trapped constraints

backend_obligation_registry.name: derive rho_R and rho_dR as the trapped characteristic constraints R=0 and dR=0
backend_obligation_registry.replacement_criterion: the two trapped constraints are derived from the Kerr Hamiltonian radial potential and matched exactly to the backend constraint expressions

backend_obligation_registry.name: prove the exported source density equals q_grav modulo those trapped constraints
backend_obligation_registry.replacement_criterion: supply a quotient identity expressing q_grav minus the backend density as trapped/gauge ideal terms plus certified nonnegative square defects
